DML.SELECT: SELECT et.element_type_id as "elementTypeId", e.element_id as "elementId", et.initial_element_type_state_id as "previousStateId", et.initial_element_type_state_id as "stateId" FROM conf.elements e, master.element_types et WHERE (e.enabled = true or e.enabled is null) AND e.element_type_id = et.element_type_id
